question: Should this PR be narrowed to the native Signal path-prefix fix before merge, with the net-policy and security-audit changes reviewed separately?
rationale: The Signal behavior is well evidenced, but the additional security-sensitive files are outside the stated fix boundary and the branch is not currently cleanly mergeable.

options.title: Narrow and rebase the Signal fix
options.body: Keep the URL helper and focused Signal tests, remove or separately propose the net-policy and audit changes, then rebase onto current main.

options.title: Review as a combined change
options.body: Retain the extra changes only if the assigned owner explicitly accepts their security scope and obtains focused validation for each behavior.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Close or pause the combined branch if the unrelated changes cannot be cleanly separated from the Signal repair.

recommendation.title: Narrow and rebase the Signal fix
recommendation.body: Keep the URL helper and focused Signal tests, remove or separately propose the net-policy and audit changes, then rebase onto current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline records an explicit assignment and no stronger current-main feature-history owner could be established from the available read-only evidence.
